layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Theropod orbital ridge morphology
features: A close-up of a theropod's eye deeply embedded within a heavy, recessed clay eye socket
The skull bone forms a thick, gnarled ridge (postorbital boss) over the top and back of the eye
The clay texture of the ridge is rough and 'pitted' like weathered stone, while the eyelid skin is softer and wrinkled
The eye is shaded by the overhanging brow ridge, creating a focused, menacing look
Muted earth tones: olive green skin transitioning into a dark, stony grey for the heavy brow bone
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic macro shot focusing on the depth of the eye socket and the heavy bone structure of the brow. The lighting comes from above to cast a shadow over the eye, emphasizing the 'embedded' look. This serves as an 'Orbital Ridge' morphology icon. No text.
